title: Environment naming grammar
description: The naming grammar of an environment schema's bindings (definitions/environment/grammar.yml, EC-0020). `conventions generate` publishes it, with each reserved prefix's vendored names, as env_grammar in index.json.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

units.description: Each unit suffix's one spelling, without its underscore, and the long forms ENVS-10 reports in its place.

boolean_prefixes.description: The prefixes a boolean binding's name starts with (ENVS-09).

boolean_suffixes.description: The suffixes a boolean's name is often given instead, which ENVS-09's message rewrites as a prefix.

client_prefixes.description: The client prefixes a schema has when it declares no naming.client_prefixes (ENVS-14).

deployment_environment.description: The one variable that carries the deployment environment, and the names that must not (ENVS-28, ENVS-30; decision 0034).

carriers.description: Names that carry the deployment environment whatever their declaration says.

carrier_suffixes.description: Name endings that carry the deployment environment.

vendor_modes.description: A framework's own mode variable, read by a library under that name; not the deployment environment.

name_words_allowed.description: Deployment environment names or slugs, upper-cased, that ENVS-30 does not report as a word of a name.

reserved_prefixes.description: Prefixes a vendor reserves: a name under one is a name that vendor defines (ENVS-29).

names.description: The file under checks/data/vendor/ that lists every name the vendor defines, with its sources.

suggest.description: A name made up under the prefix, mapped to the vendor's name for what it means.

runner_only.description: The vendor sets its names only inside a CI run, so a service declares none of them.
